- Failed payment: /checkout/success?status=failed shows retry UI with correct messaging

## Canonical Issue: Checkout Address Slice

This is the single source of truth for the address collection feature in the checkout system.

## What the Feature Should Do

Address page (/checkout/address) collects shipping address from user: first name, last name, phone number, country, city, street, street number, postal code. Validates required fields. Saves to iron-session. Redirects to /checkout/shipping on success. Guards: redirects to /basket if no basket items.

Email capture is OUT of scope for address page. Email is collected on the payment page (see issue cdy).

## What the Feature Should Look Like (Visual UX)

- [ ] Address page design (visual look on mobile/desktop) should be 100% up to professional ecommerce best practices / first principles, and aligned to the design system.
- [ ] Visual design specification: docs/checkout/shipping/ux-should-be-intelligence.md`n
## Source Code IS

### app/(store)/checkout/address/page.tsx
- Server Component
- Reads checkout session via getCheckoutSession()
- Guard: redirects to /basket if !session.basket or basket.length === 0
- Logs session.basket to server console
- Renders AddressForm with traceId from session.checkoutSessionId

### app/(store)/checkout/address/AddressForm
- Client Component
- Form fields: country, city, street, street number, postal code
- Submit action saves address to iron-session
- Missing: firstName, lastName, phone fields (now IN scope, to be added)

### lib/session.ts
- CheckoutSession interface includes address: { country, city, street, streetNumber, postalCode }
- Optional: email, phone (not currently in interface)

## Live Checks + Logs vs Should Be

- [ ] Navigate to /checkout/address with basket items -> form renders (including firstName, lastName, phone fields)
- [ ] Submit valid address -> saved to session, redirect to /checkout/shipping
- [ ] Navigate without basket items -> redirect to /basket
- [ ] Validation: empty required fields -> error shown
- [ ] Address persists in session when returning via Back button

## Notes

Polish carriers require recipient name + phone for delivery. These fields are now IN scope for the address form.

Email is needed for order confirmations but is NOT collected on the address page - it belongs to the payment page (issue cdy P1).

## Scope: HAPPY PATH ONLY

This issue tracks the happy path for address collection. Out of scope:
- Email capture (separate issue: cdy P1, collected on payment page)
- Address validation beyond required fields
- Address autocomplete / lookup

## Edge Cases Path

Status: LOCKED until happy path live checks pass

Known concerns (placeholder):
- Invalid postal code format
- Address validation beyond required fields
- Email capture (merged from cdy -- handled on payment page)
- Address autocomplete / lookup
- Migrate Address from Stripe Metadata to First-Class Shipping Parameter (merged from sang-logium-4nj): Currently payment page flattens address fields into Stripe PaymentIntent metadata. Should pass address as structured shipping parameter for Radar fraud signals + Dashboard visibility.

Auth.js v5 was taken over by Better Auth team in September 2025. Auth.js is now security-patch mode only. Better Auth is the actively developed, framework-native alternative, recommended by Auth.js maintainers and listed as a recommended library by Next.js itself.

Sources:
- https://github.com/nextauthjs/next-auth/discussions/13252 — "If you're starting something new... we recommend Better Auth"
- https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/authentication — Better Auth listed under recommended Auth Libraries

═══ NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS ═══

2. /sign-up route — new account creation with email/password
3. Session management via Better Auth database-stored sessions. DB-stored session tokens; cookie holds the reference. Immediate revocation by deleting the session row. NOT JWT.
4. middleware.ts route protection for /account/* routes. Lightweight cookie-presence check only (NO runtime: "nodejs" — experimental in Next 15, subject to breaking changes). Full auth.api.getSession() validation inside protected Server Components.
5. Guest checkout must remain fully functional (no forced auth at checkout)
6. Post-purchase account creation offer on /checkout/success

8. Sanity as canonical user profile store (addresses, preferences) — Better Auth owns identity only

═══ CORRECTED TECHNICAL STACK (May 29, 2026) ═══

Database (local): better-sqlite3 → file:./auth.db
Database (prod):  @libsql/client + kysely-libsql → libsql://your-db.turso.io
Password hash:    Better Auth native scrypt (NO bcrypt-ts — dead code, Better Auth handles this)
Form state:       useActionState from react (React 19.2.6). useFormState from react-dom is deprecated.
Middleware:       getSessionCookie() for lightweight cookie check. NO runtime: "nodejs".
Plugin order:     [..., nextCookies()] — nextCookies() MUST be the LAST plugin or Server Action cookie writes fail silently.
Migration:        npx @better-auth/cli migrate — prerequisite before any sign-up/sign-in works.
Sanity schema:    userType.ts with authId (string, required, maps to Better Auth user.id), email, name
OAuth setup:      Register callback URIs in Google/GitHub developer consoles:
                  https://<domain>/api/auth/callback/google
                  https://<domain>/api/auth/callback/github

Auth instance:    lib/auth.ts
  import { betterAuth } from "better-auth"
  import { nextCookies } from "better-auth/next-js"
  export const auth = betterAuth({
    database: /* conditional: better-sqlite3 (dev) or kysely-libsql (prod) */,
    socialProviders: { google: {...}, github: {...} },
    plugins: [nextCookies()],  // REQUIRED — must be LAST plugin

API route:        app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts

  import { toNextJsHandler } from "better-auth/next-js"

Client:           lib/auth-client.ts

═══ DATA ACCESS LAYER ═══

Create lib/auth/dal.ts with verifySession() wrapped in React's cache():

  import { cache } from "react"
  import { auth } from "@/lib/auth"
  import { headers } from "next/headers"
  import { redirect } from "next/navigation"

  export const verifySession = cache(async () => {
    const session = await auth.api.getSession({ headers: await headers() })
    if (!session) redirect("/sign-in")
    return { isAuth: true, userId: session.user.id, user: session.user }
  })

Use in Server Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers. React cache() deduplicates within a render pass.

═══ MIDDLEWARE DESIGN (iron-session + Better Auth Coexistence) ═══

Two independent cookie systems — orthogonal concerns, zero conflict:

  - What you're BUYING: basket, address, shippingCode, shippingCost, paymentIntentId, email
  - httpOnly, secure (prod), sameSite: "lax", maxAge: 1 hour
  - Encrypted with SESSION_SECRET
  - Read ONLY in Server Actions and page.tsx — NEVER in middleware
  - 100% PRECEDENCE — checkout is the centerpiece, 10x more important than auth

  better-auth.session_token cookie (Better Auth):
  - Who you ARE: identity, user ID, session reference
  - httpOnly, secure (prod)
  - Session token stored in DB, cookie holds the reference

- Pass-through for /checkout/*, /basket, /sign-in, /sign-up (no auth interference)
- iron-session is NEVER touched by middleware
- A user can have either cookie, both, or neither — they are independent

- Sanity owns user profile data via separate user document type

## Frame ÔÇö 2026-06-03 ÔÇö Bug Fix: Edit Save (Shell Arg Quoting)

### Objective
Fix bd update value corruption on Windows: multi-word/multiline field values are split by cmd.exe when server.mjs invokes bd via execFile+shell:true, causing data loss in Dolt DB.

### Root Cause (confirmed)
server.mjs execFile('bd', ['update', id, '--notes', value], {shell:true}) routes through cmd.exe which does NOT quote the value. 'word1 word2 word3' arrives at bd.js as three separate argv tokens: --notes=word1, id2=word2, id3=word3. Notes are truncated to first word. Original notes are overwritten and irrecoverable.

### Core Work

#### Tasks
1. server.mjs ÔÇö Replace execFile+shell:true with Node.js-direct invocation: read bd.js absolute path from bd.cmd at startup (extract from last line), then execFile(process.execPath, [bdJsPath, 'update', id, '--'+field, value], {cwd:repoRoot, shell:false}). shell:false passes argv array directly to node.exe via CreateProcess ÔÇö no cmd.exe, no token splitting, no quoting issues.
2. server.mjs ÔÇö Same fix for bd export call: execFile(process.execPath, [bdJsPath, 'export', '-o', ISSUES_FILE], {cwd:repoRoot, shell:false})
3. index.html:saveField ÔÇö After fetch .then() success, call exitEdit() before the 1.5s button reset. This returns user to view mode which re-renders from the SSE-updated issues data, giving visual confirmation of what was actually persisted.
4. index.html:renderBoard ÔÇö When editMode===true, skip replacing the open issue in issues array (preserve backing data during active edit). Prevents Cancel from showing SSE-stale data: var updated = data.find(function(i){return i.id===openIssueId;}); if(updated && !editMode) { var idx=issues.findIndex(...); if(idx>-1) issues[idx]=updated; } else if(!editMode) { issues=data; }

#### Acceptance
- [ ] Save 'hello world' as notes -> hard refresh -> still shows 'hello world' (not truncated to 'hello')
- [ ] Save multiline notes (3+ lines) -> hard refresh -> full content preserved
- [ ] Save -> automatically exits edit mode, view panel shows saved content
- [ ] Click Cancel without saving -> shows original pre-edit content (not blank, not truncated)
- [ ] passes /checks: 0 gaps, 0 red flags

### Advanced Features ÔÇö LOCKED until happy path passes

#### Known concerns
- notes field has no --notes-file flag; stdin-based fix only works for description. The node-direct invocation (Task 1) handles both.
- If bd.js path changes on npm update, startup path-read from bd.cmd stays correct.
- Multiline content with special chars (quotes, backslashes) verified by node-direct path.
- Cancel-without-save data loss: no unsaved-changes warning yet.

#### Next Steps
1. Complete all happy path tasks
2. Run all acceptance checks with evidence
3. Update issue: 'Happy path complete ÔÇö unlocking edge cases'
